basic_details.job_title: Jadavpur University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jadavpur University, Kolkata, West Bengal, has invited applications for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF). Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 22 November 2026.

application_fee.all_candidates_fee: Rs 50 (cost of application form, paid online at the time of download)
application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online, through the payment link on the Jadavpur University website, at the time of download of the application form.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Geology, Earth Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related discipline from a recognised university, with valid NET or GATE qualification (mandatory).
qualification.details: Qualification: M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Geology, Earth Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related discipline from a recognised university; Valid NET or GATE qualification (mandatory) Experience: Desirable: experience in environmental sample collection and preparation, trace metal analysis, analytical instrumentation (AAS/ICP-MS/ICP-OES), environmental geochemistry, or human exposure assessment Age limit: Maximum 30 years Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As allowed following Government of India rules | Other conditions: | Valid NET or GATE qualification is mandatory | Desirable: | Experience in environmental sample collection and preparation, trace metal analysis or analytical instrumentation (AAS/ICP-MS/ICP-OES) Experience in environmental geochemistry or human exposure assessment Previous research experience, fieldwork experience and publications in relevant areas are additional advantages

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 37,000 per month (consolidated) in first and second years; Rs. 42,000 per month (consolidated) in third year; no HRA

how_to_apply: Obtain the paper application form from the Information Section of Jadavpur University on any working day, or download it from the University's download centre (Application Form – Research (2 in a Set)).
Pay Rs 50/- online through the payment link on the Jadavpur University website at the time of downloading the form.
Compile the application form, updated CV, certificates and mark sheets, NET/GATE proof, experience certificates and publications into a single PDF file.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with subject 'Application for JRF Position – Coefficient Giving BLL Project'.
important_instructions: All documents must be compiled into a single PDF file No House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be provided No TA/DA for attending the interview

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Geology, Earth Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related discipline from a recognised university; Valid NET or GATE qualification (mandatory) Experience: Desirable: experience in environmental sample collection and preparation, trace metal analysis, analytical instrumentation (AAS/ICP-MS/ICP-OES), environmental geochemistry, or human exposure assessment Age limit: Maximum 30 years Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As allowed following Government of India rules Other conditions: Valid NET or GATE qualification is mandatory Desirable: Experience in environmental sample collection and preparation, trace metal analysis or analytical instrumentation (AAS/ICP-MS/ICP-OES) Experience in environmental geochemistry or human exposure assessment Previous research experience, fieldwork experience and publications in relevant areas are additional advantages

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration three years, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds Initial appointment for one year; may be extended based on performance and project requirements Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project No claim for regular appointment or absorption at Jadavpur University

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online, through the payment link on the Jadavpur University website, at the time of download of the application form.

content_sections.text: Application form Updated curriculum vitae (CV) Copies of educational certificates and mark sheets Proof of NET/GATE qualification Copies of publications, if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jadavpur University Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Obtain the paper application form from the Information Section of Jadavpur University on any working day, or download it from the University's download centre (Application Form – Research (2 in a Set)). Pay Rs 50/- online through the payment link on the Jadavpur University website at the time of downloading the form. Compile the application form, updated CV, certificates and mark sheets, NET/GATE proof, experience certificates and publications into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] with subject 'Application for JRF Position – Coefficient Giving BLL Project'. Send the application by 22nd Nov, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All documents must be compiled into a single PDF file No House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be provided No TA/DA for attending the interview

content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Jadavpur University, dated 4 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Jadavpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Jadavpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Jadavpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 22 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs 50 (cost of application form, paid online at the time of download).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PWD As allowed following Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000 per month (consolidated) in first and second years; Rs. 42,000 per month (consolidated) in third year; no HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. or M.Tech. in Environmental Science, Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Geology, Earth Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related discipline from a recognised university, with valid NET or GATE qualification (mandatory).

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid NET or GATE qualification is mandatory.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration three years, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of project funds. Initial appointment for one year; may be extended based on performance and project requirements. Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.
